note.p: There are several possibilities here. We have grouped the Hutchinson entries together. See Ed Pope's note:

Possibly Bury Hutchinson, attorney and clerk to the Brewers Company at Aldermanbury from 1799 till his death in 1824. He died 3.10.1824 at Sydenham was buried at St Helen's Bishopsgate on 22.10.1824 aged 73, of Bloomsbury Square, which would make him a neighbour as well as a fellow lawyer of Foulkes. However there are other Hutchinsons in the Law Lists and Boyle's Court Guides. Later Hutchinsons could be the same but the name was quite common. A Mrs Hutchinson lived at 7 Polygon in 1799 so a near neighbour of the Godwins but none of the entries above apart from the 3 calls in 1809 were at Godwin's or Hutchinson's which does not suggest a neighbour Bury H bach otp = 24.5.1783 St Mary Aldermanbury by lic Esther Mary Glover of St Helens Ldn wit Natty Hutchinson. Bury H Addle St 1783,1785. Bury H of Brewers Hall took appr Wm Dobree 1799. Will PCC 1828 John Hutchinson gent of Wrexham (seen but gave no clues about Sir Richard).
Clearly, the entries for 1825, 1832, and 11835 cannot be Bury Hutchinson, but may refer to a son.
